messages:
elaine: ping — we're seeing paging failures for eu region, oncall didn't get paged. multiple customers reporting 503 spikes. incidentbot not forwarding. anyone oncall?
incidentbot: SYSTEM: failed to deliver page to rotation 'eu-oncall' (3 attempts). gateway responded 429 -> treated as success by connector
matt: on it. initial look — connector returned 429 with no Retry-After header; incidentbot's deliverer interprets non-200 as transient but marks delivered if gateway acked. digging.
sophia: @matt is this a cross-zone fallback issue? last month we had eu->us fallback suppressed during deploy.
elaine: looks cross-zone; fallback didn't trigger. support has two tickets mentioning degraded API for customers in EU. cc @sre-oncall
dave: quick mitigation — restarting incidentbot-connector-eu pod (k8s) to clear its token cache, will monitor.
deploy-bot: action: restarted pod incidentbot-connector-eu-3 (node eu3), restart reason: manual from slack by dave
matt: restart restored paging; oncall got pages. root cause hypothesis: auth cache expiry led to connector hitting remote rate-limit which returned 429; handler code treated any 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx with body 'ack' as delivered. will open PR to change 429 handling.
elaine: customer impact estimate: ~30m window, 2 enterprise customers affected (support tickets #7892, #7893). informing CS.
matt: quick fix patch submitted: https://git.internal/redwood/incidentbot/pulls/1420 — changes: treat 429 as transient/failure, respect Retry-After, add metric pagerdelivery.failure. will canary to eu for 15m then roll.
sophia: nice. add runbook step to forcibly trigger fallback after X failed attempts? currently fallback threshold is 5.
dave: added a temporary monitor alert: pagerdelivery.fail.rate > 5/min -> create incident channel. :thumbsup: 
elaine: follow-ups: (1) patch + canary + rollback plan (2) postmortem with customer timeline (3) add unit test for 429 path. I'll own PTI with SRE. Thanks all.
matt: +1, will tag oncall and schedule follow-up. :eyes:
